reason: A voice-input plugin that records microphone audio in the browser, uses a local SenseVoice service for transcription, and inserts the resulting text into the DeepSeek Harness input field.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器录音并调用本地 SenseVoice 服务将语音转写为文字后填入 DeepSeek Harness 输入框的语音输入插件。
summaries.en: A voice-input plugin that records audio in the browser, transcribes it through a local SenseVoice service, and inserts the text into the DeepSeek Harness input field.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio through the browser
Transcribes recorded audio using a local SenseVoice service
Automatically downloads a speech model and installs Python dependencies
Starts local backend processes and inserts transcription into the chat input
Manages installed speech models, including removal and redownload
